dir="auto">DBeaver EE and DBeaver Eclipse plugin versions support passwords storage in secured database (encrypted with master password).<br>
You can enable this in Preferences->Database->Security.</p>
<p dir="auto">Regarding CE version:<br>
Many users share database configurations so they need to keep password in the same configuration file (which is actually resides in some version control system).<br>
But if your database passwords are secure then you can disable passwords save at all.</p>
<p dir="auto">Note: password are saved not in plain text but in encrypted form (so you can't see them accidentally). But they can be easily decrypted with special software.</p></div></div><div role="toolbar" aria-label="Reactions" class="d-flex gap-1 flex-wrap"><div class="ReactionPopoverAnchor__B84pko"><button
